apps.name: SkyRadar
apps.subtitle: ATC-style aircraft radar
apps.localizedDescription:
A real-time air traffic radar scope for your local airspace.

Connects to a local docker-adsb-ultrafeeder receiver over HTTP or HTTPS, with automatic fallback to public ADSB feeds when the receiver is unreachable. The scope orients to the compass so traffic appears where you are actually looking. Tap any aircraft for callsign, altitude, speed, heading, type, and operator.

versions.localizedDescription:
• Private trackers are now a list — add several receivers and switch between them
• Each receiver has its own name, shown on the radar status badge instead of "LOCAL"
• Indicator light per receiver shows reachability at a glance, with a Test All button
• Receiver URLs drop the port when it is the scheme default
• Switching a receiver to HTTPS moves port 80 to 443 automatically
• Existing receiver settings migrate across automatically
